name: Push-Up
steps: Start on the floor in a high plank with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers spread, and body aligned straight from head to heels.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes tightly to keep your torso rigid.
Bend your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle from your ribs to lower your chest smoothly until it hovers just above the floor.
Press firmly through your palms to extend your elbows back to the starting plank position.
tips: Keep your hips level with your shoulders rather than sagging your lower back or lifting your hips high.
Keep your neck neutral by looking at the floor slightly ahead of your hands.
